subject: #149 error-text registry: per-ROW reading CONFIRMED s320; interleave only, never a campaign
description: Fable ruling (fable-answers-s318.md §3): (a) the strict reading is confirmed — a row asserting a side-effect did not happen, or any behaviour/value of VALID Perl, never registers under the error-text category, even inside a qualifying family (§6d's "checks a value" extends to "checks a behaviour"). Boundary note: do.t t63/t65 register anyway, but on principle-9 grounds (the INPUT is invalid modern Perl) — see #158. (b) The remaining ~45 candidate rows: register them when already in the file for other reasons; no dedicated scanning sessions — near-green silent-wrong work outranks this bookkeeping.
